name: Visual Art and Design
boundary: Art materials, composition and design practice; exclude musical performance and general aesthetic adjectives.

name: Music and Performance
boundary: Musical structure and performance; exclude general art and electronics.

name: Ecology and Conservation
boundary: Organisms in ecosystems and conservation; exclude cellular biology and geographic landforms.

name: Genetics and Cellular Biology
boundary: Heredity and cellular processes; exclude figurative reproduction and social inheritance.

name: Disease and Epidemiology
boundary: Disease transmission and population health; exclude medicines and purely anatomical terms.

name: Geology and Earth Processes
boundary: Rocks, strata and geological change; exclude human geography.

name: Weather and Climate
boundary: Atmosphere, weather systems and climate; exclude astronomical bodies.

name: Agriculture and Land Management
boundary: Cultivation and agricultural production; exclude cooking and wild ecosystems.

name: Historical Periods and Movements
boundary: Named historical periods and historical change; exclude current civic procedures.

name: Government and Civic Institutions
boundary: Government institutions and public administration; exclude litigation and social theory.

name: War and Diplomacy
boundary: Military organization, conflict and international relations; exclude metaphorical attacks.

name: Mechanics and Machines
boundary: Machine parts and mechanical motion; exclude mathematical uses.

name: Construction and Civil Engineering
boundary: Built structures, construction and infrastructure; exclude historical periods.

name: Electronics and Electrical Engineering
boundary: Circuits and electrical devices; exclude figurative connections.

name: Computing and Software
boundary: Computational systems, programming and networking; exclude ordinary senses of technical homonyms.

name: Materials and Chemical Processes
boundary: Material properties and chemical transformations; exclude fixed element cohorts.

name: Physics and Measurement
boundary: Physical principles and scientific measurement; exclude figurative wavelengths.

name: Psychology and Cognition
boundary: Mental processes and psychological constructs; exclude casual evaluations.

name: Society and Social Behavior
boundary: Social conventions, groups and interactions; exclude mathematical norms and religious doctrine.

name: Philosophy and Ethics
boundary: Philosophical arguments and ethical frameworks; exclude religious offices and everyday praise.

name: Economics and Markets
boundary: Economic mechanisms and market analysis; exclude accounting procedures.

name: Finance and Accounting
boundary: Financial instruments, accounts and financial reporting; exclude general quantities.

name: Business and Organizations
boundary: Organizational management and commercial operations; exclude legal proceedings.

name: Statistics and Data Analysis
boundary: Probability, statistical inference and data interpretation; exclude social norms.

name: Communication and Rhetoric
boundary: Discourse, rhetorical devices and communication practices; exclude grammatical structure.

name: Figurative Language and Imagery
boundary: Conventional nonliteral senses with a recognizable physical, natural or concrete image. This is not a destination for every abstract word or an unfamiliar literal sense. Exclude plain personal qualities (1300), evaluations (1303), and abstract states/relations (1304).

name: Advanced Character, Thought and Feelings
boundary: Everyday advanced vocabulary for character, attitudes, emotions, thought, personal judgment and interpersonal behavior. Exclude clinical/academic psychology (1062), general evaluation of objects or claims (1303), and physical-image metaphors (1182).

name: Advanced Actions, Change and Movement
boundary: Concrete or everyday actions, movement, handling, gradual change, time and spatial arrangement. Exclude technical domain processes, personal thought/feeling (1300), metaphorical images (1182), and abstract conditions/causality (1304).

name: Advanced Everyday Life, Roles and Objects
boundary: Daily living, household items, clothing, accommodation, services, social titles/roles and practical routines. Exclude specialist domain senses, abstract states (1304), evaluation (1303), and descriptive modifiers without a daily-life topic (1180).

name: Advanced Evaluation, Value and Certainty
boundary: General judgments about merit, usefulness, importance, correctness, originality and certainty, expressed as adjectives, nouns, adverbs or verbs. Exclude personal temperament and emotional states (1300), sensory description or mere degree (1180), specialist formal logic, and concrete imagery (1182).

name: Advanced States, Relations and Consequences
boundary: Abstract conditions, limits, dependencies, mutual relations, developments, outcomes and causal/temporal relationships. Exclude personal emotions/attitudes (1300), concrete actions or movements (1301), evaluative claims (1303), recognizable figurative images (1182), and specialist domain terms.

name: Advanced Character, Thought and Feelings 2
boundary: Everyday advanced vocabulary for character, attitudes, emotions, thought, personal judgment and interpersonal behavior. Exclude clinical/academic psychology (1062), general evaluation of objects or claims (1303), and physical-image metaphors (1182).

name: Advanced Character, Thought and Feelings 3
boundary: Everyday advanced vocabulary for character, attitudes, emotions, thought, personal judgment and interpersonal behavior. Exclude clinical/academic psychology (1062), general evaluation of objects or claims (1303), and physical-image metaphors (1182).

name: Advanced Actions, Change and Movement 2
boundary: Concrete or everyday actions, movement, handling, gradual change, time and spatial arrangement. Exclude technical domain processes, personal thought/feeling (1300), metaphorical images (1182), and abstract conditions/causality (1304).

name: Advanced Actions, Change and Movement 3
boundary: Concrete or everyday actions, movement, handling, gradual change, time and spatial arrangement. Exclude technical domain processes, personal thought/feeling (1300), metaphorical images (1182), and abstract conditions/causality (1304).

name: Figurative Language and Imagery 2
boundary: Conventional nonliteral senses with a recognizable physical, natural or concrete image. This is not a destination for every abstract word or an unfamiliar literal sense. Exclude plain personal qualities (1300), evaluations (1303), and abstract states/relations (1304).

name: Advanced Adverbs
boundary: Advanced general manner and usage adverbs that do not fit a dedicated adverb type or specialist subject. Share this boundary with volume 2. Exclude ordinary A1–B1 senses (105/324), degree/focus (1342), stance/certainty (1343), linking (1344), and time/frequency/direction (1345).

name: Advanced Adverbs 2
boundary: Advanced general manner and usage adverbs that do not fit a dedicated adverb type or specialist subject. Share this boundary with volume 2. Exclude ordinary A1–B1 senses (105/324), degree/focus (1342), stance/certainty (1343), linking (1344), and time/frequency/direction (1345).

name: Advanced Degree and Focus Adverbs
boundary: Advanced adverb senses expressing extent, intensity, approximation, limitation, emphasis or focus. Exclude general manner, stance/certainty, discourse linking and literal temporal/spatial direction. Familiar headword CEFR does not make every intensifying sense elementary.

name: Advanced Stance and Certainty Adverbs
boundary: Advanced epistemic, evidential, attitudinal and viewpoint adverb senses: how a claim is known, qualified, interpreted or regarded. Exclude ordinary manner, mere degree, and discourse connectors.

name: Advanced Linking and Organizing Adverbs
boundary: Advanced adverbs connecting or organizing propositions, arguments or discourse through contrast, consequence, addition, concession or sequence. Ordinary connectors remain in general units, including 227.

name: Advanced Time, Frequency and Direction Adverbs
boundary: Advanced temporal, frequency, duration, spatial-location and directional adverb senses. Exclude argumentative/discourse sequencing (1344), epistemic stance (1343), and ordinary everyday time/direction adverbs in general units.

name: Advanced Feelings and Reactions
boundary: Advanced or nuanced senses of emotions, affective reactions, emotional expressions and their sources or effects; a continuation of 100. Ordinary everyday feelings remain at 100/303. Character/cognition belongs in 1300-family units, and clinical/academic psychology belongs in 1062.

name: Advanced Ideas, Roles and Results
boundary: Advanced abstract noun senses for ideas, conceptual roles, functions, implications, outcomes, achievements and fulfillment; a continuation of 222. Exclude ordinary everyday noun senses, concrete objects, and clear specialist meanings with their own topic. Do not infer sense difficulty solely from spelling-level CEFR.

name: Advanced Describing and Qualifying Words
boundary: Advanced or nuanced adjective senses qualifying condition, composition, scope, suitability, implications or interpretation; a shared advanced continuation of 106 and 318. Ordinary everyday descriptions remain in general units. Prefer specific specialist topics when the definition is explicitly domain-specific; adverbs have separate units.
